topic.readerProblem: Calculate Otterly.AI plan and add-on cost without confusing prompts with engine coverage.

assessment: The final guide separates base prompt capacity from optional engine coverage, lists tax-exclusive USD prices, and prevents the Standard-plus-Gemini calculation from being mistaken for more prompt capacity. It makes no claim about measured accuracy or account behavior.
